file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue arises because the current CSV export code merges rows based on date, amount, and description without considering the currency. The `writeCsv` function in `src/export/csv.ts` writes the rows in order but does not differentiate rows with the same date, amount, and description but different currencies, causing only one of them to appear in the exported CSV.

A fix would involve modifying the CSV writing logic or the data preparation step to treat transactions with different currencies as distinct entries, ensuring they all appear in the CSV export.

input.title: Fix CSV export merging rows with different currencies
input.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current CSV export in src/export/csv.ts merges rows that have identical date, amount, and description but different currencies, causing only one row to appear in the exported CSV instead of both. This likely results from the CSV writer not distinguishing rows by currency.

Proposed change: modify the CSV export logic to consider currency as part of the uniqueness criteria when writing rows, ensuring transactions with different currencies but otherwise identical attributes are not merged and both appear separately in the exported CSV output.
